final: SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination' ORDER BY a.attribute_name    -- Returns all attributes and their values for Abomination: Intelligence (85), Strength (80), Speed (55), Durability (55), Power (55), Combat (55)
